summary: Staff can upload images and files into Editor.js blocks; uploads are stored on the public disk and referenced by absolute storage URLs.
detailed_changes: Added POST /staff/media/upload for authenticated staff (image and file kinds with size/MIME limits).
Wired Editor.js image uploadByFile and a File block file picker; by-URL helpers remain.
Ensured deploy activate creates the public/storage symlink so uploaded media is served.
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff editors; public readers of articles that include uploaded media
Public impact: published articles may reference newly uploaded images/files under /storage/editor
Internal impact: staff no longer need external hosts for basic image/file blocks
